name: express-service-platform
description: 快递综合服务平台 monorepo（保留快递100 Java SDK）

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:clients
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @express-platform/shared-types && npm run build -w @express-platform/api-client && npm run build -w @express-platform/ui-components
scripts.build:clients: npm run build:h5 -w @express-platform/user-app && npm run build:h5 -w @express-platform/courier-app && npm run build -w @express-platform/admin-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @express-platform/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/ui-components && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/api && npm run typecheck:clients
scripts.typecheck:clients: npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/user-app && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/courier-app && npm run typecheck -w @express-platform/admin-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @express-platform/api && npm run test -w @express-platform/api-client
